import pychrono.core as chrono
import pychrono.irrlicht as irr
import pychrono.vehicle as veh
import math

chrono.SetChronoDataPath(chrono.GetChronoDataPath())
veh.SetDataPath(chrono.GetChronoDataPath() + 'vehicle/')

# Initial vehicle location and orientation
initLoc = chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0.5)
initRot = chrono.ChQuaterniond(1, 0, 0, 0)

# Visualization type for vehicle parts (PRIMITIVES, MESH, or NONE)
vis_type = veh.VisualizationType_MESH

# Collision type for chassis (PRIMITIVES, MESH, or NONE)
chassis_collision_type = veh.CollisionType_NONE

# Type of tire model (RIGID, TMEASY)
tire_model = veh.TireModelType_TMEASY

# Rigid terrain
# terrain_model = veh.RigidTerrain.BOX
terrainHeight = 0      # terrain height
terrainLength = 100.0  # size in X direction
terrainWidth = 100.0   # size in Y direction

# Poon chassis tracked by the camera
trackPoint = chrono.ChVector3d(-3.0, 0.0, 1.1)

# Contact method
contact_method = chrono.ChContactMethod_NSC
contact_vis = False

# Simulation step sizes
step_size = 1e-3
tire_step_size = step_size

# Time interval between two render frames
render_step_size = 1.0 / 50  # FPS = 50

# Create the FEDA vehicle, set parameters, and initialize
vehicle = veh.FEDA()
vehicle.SetContactMethod(contact_method)
vehicle.SetChassisCollisionType(chassis_collision_type)
vehicle.SetChassisFixed(False)
vehicle.SetInitPosition(chrono.ChCoordsysd(initLoc, initRot))
vehicle.SetTireType(tire_model)
vehicle.SetTireStepSize(tire_step_size)


vehicle.Initialize()

vehicle.SetChassisVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetSuspensionVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetSteeringVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetWheelVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetTireVisualizationType(vis_type)

vehicle.GetSystem().SetCollisionSystemType(chrono.ChCollisionSystem.Type_BULLET)

# Create the terrain
patch_mat = chrono.ChContactMaterialNSC()
patch_mat.SetFriction(0.9)
patch_mat.SetRestitution(0.01)
terrain = veh.RigidTerrain(vehicle.GetSystem())
patch = terrain.AddPatch(patch_mat, 
    chrono.ChCoordsysd(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0), chrono.QUNIT), 
    terrainLength, terrainWidth)

patch.SetTexture(veh.GetDataFile("terrain/textures/tile4.jpg"), 200, 200)
patch.SetColor(chrono.ChColor(0.8, 0.8, 0.5))
terrain.Initialize()

# Create the vehicle Irrlicht interface

vis = veh.ChWheeledVehicleVisualSystemIrrlicht()
vis.SetWindowTitle('FEDA vehicle')
vis.SetWindowSize(1280, 1024)
vis.SetChaseCamera(trackPoint, 6.0, 0.5)
vis.Initialize()
vis.AddLogo(chrono.GetChronoDataFile('logo_pychrono_alpha.png'))
vis.AddLightDirectional()
vis.AddSkyBox()
vis.AttachVehicle(vehicle.GetVehicle())


# Create the driver system
driver = veh.ChInteractiveDriverIRR(vis)

# Set the time response for steering and throttle keyboard inputs.
steering_time = 1.0  # time to go from 0 to +1 (or from 0 to -1)
throttle_time = 1.0  # time to go from 0 to +1
braking_time = 0.3   # time to go from 0 to +1
driver.SetSteeringDelta(render_step_size / steering_time)
driver.SetThrottleDelta(render_step_size / throttle_time)
driver.SetBrakingDelta(render_step_size / braking_time)

driver.Initialize()

# output vehicle mass
print( "VEHICLE MASS: ",  vehicle.GetVehicle().GetMass())

# Number of simulation steps between miscellaneous events
render_steps = math.ceil(render_step_size / step_size)

# Initialize simulation frame counter s
realtime_timer = chrono.ChRealtimeStepTimer()
step_number = 0
render_frame = 0

while vis.Run() :
    time = vehicle.GetSystem().GetChTime()

    # Render scene and output POV-Ray data
    if (step_number % render_steps == 0) :
        vis.BeginScene()
        vis.Render()
        vis.EndScene()
        render_frame += 1

    # Get driver inputs
    driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()

    # Update modules (process inputs from other modules)
    driver.Synchronize(time)
    terrain.Synchronize(time)
    vehicle.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs, terrain)
    vis.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs)

    # Advance simulation for one timestep for all modules
    driver.Advance(step_size)
    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle.Advance(step_size)
    vis.Advance(step_size)

    # Increment frame number
    step_number += 1

    # Spin in place for real time to catch up
    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)

```python
import pychrono as chrono
import pychrono.vehicle as veh
import pychrono.irrlicht as chronoirr

# 1. Initialize the PyChrono environment and core components
chrono.SetChronoDataPath(chrono.GetChronoDataPath())  # Ensure data path is set

# Simulation parameters
step_size = 1.0 / 50  # 50 FPS

# 2. Add the required physical systems and objects as specified

# Create the vehicle system
contact_method = chrono.ChContactMethod_NSC  # Non-smooth contact
initial_loc = chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 1.0)  # Starting 1 meter above ground
initial_rot = chrono.ChQuaternionD(1, 0, 0, 0)  # No rotation

# Initialize the FEDA vehicle
vehicle = veh.FEDA(contact_method)
vehicle.SetInitPosition(chrono.ChCoordsysD(initial_loc, initial_rot))
vehicle.SetChassisCollisionType(veh.ChassisCollisionType_NONE)  # No chassis collision for simplicity
vehicle.SetTireType(veh.TireModelType_TMEASY)  # Tire model
vehicle.Initialize()

# Set visualization type for all vehicle parts to mesh
vehicle.SetChassisVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_MESH)
vehicle.SetSuspensionVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_MESH)
vehicle.SetSteeringVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_MESH)
vehicle.SetWheelVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_MESH)
vehicle.SetTireVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_MESH)

# Create the terrain
terrain = veh.RigidTerrain(vehicle.GetSystem())
terrain.SetContactFriction(0.9f)
terrain.SetContactRestitution(0.01f)
terrain.SetContactMaterialProperties(0.9, 0.01, 2e7, 0.3)  # friction, restitution, young_modulus, poisson_ratio

# Add a patch (rigid terrain surface)
patch = terrain.AddPatch(chrono.ChCoordsysD(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0), chrono.QUNIT),
                         200, 200)  # 200m x 200m patch
patch.SetTexture(veh.GetDataFile("terrain/textures/grass.jpg"), 200, 200)
patch.SetColor(chrono.ChColor(0.8, 0.8, 0.5))
patch.SetContactFriction(0.9)
patch.SetContactRestitution(0.01)
patch.SetContactMaterialProperties(0.9, 0.01, 2e7, 0.3)
terrain.Initialize()

# 3. Set necessary default parameters such as positions, forces, and interactions.

# Create the Irrlicht application for visualization
app = chronoirr.ChIrrApp(vehicle.GetSystem(), "FEDA Vehicle on Rigid Terrain",
                         chronoirr.dimension2du(1280, 720))

# Add typical elements to the Irrlicht scene
app.AddTypicalSky()
app.AddTypicalLights()
app.AddTypicalCamera(chronoirr.vector3df(0, -8, 3))

# Set camera to follow the vehicle from a designated position
app.SetChaseCamera(trackPoint=chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 1.2),
                   chaseDistance=8.0,
                   chaseHeight=3.0,
                   chaseAngle=0.5)

# Initialize the app
app.AssetBindAll()
app.AssetUpdateAll()
app.SetTimestep(step_size)

# Create the interactive driver system
driver = veh.ChIrrGuiDriver(app)
driver.SetSteeringDelta(0.06)
driver.SetThrottleDelta(0.1)
driver.SetBrakingDelta(0.2)
driver.Initialize()

# Initialize vehicle subsystems
vehicle.Initialize()

# Simulation loop
while app.GetDevice().run():
    app.BeginScene()
    app.DrawAll()

    # Get driver inputs
    driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()

    # Apply driver inputs to vehicle
    vehicle.GetSteeringController().SetInput(driver_inputs.m_steering)
    vehicle.GetPowertrain().SetThrottle(driver_inputs.m_throttle)
    vehicle.GetBrake().SetBrake(driver_inputs.m_braking)

    # Advance simulation by step size
    driver.Synchronize(step_size)
    terrain.Synchronize(step_size)
    vehicle.Synchronize(step_size, driver_inputs, terrain)
    app.DoStep()

    app.EndScene()
```

```python
# Increased terrain length from 100.0 to 200.0 per instructions
terrainHeight = 0      # terrain height
terrainLength = 200.0  # size in X direction
terrainWidth = 100.0   # size in Y direction

# Point tracked by the camera
trackPoint = chrono.ChVector3d(-53.0, 0.0, 1.1)  # Adjusted slightly to follow vehicle start

# Contact method
contact_method = chrono.ChContactMethod_NSC
contact_vis = False

# Simulation step sizes
step_size = 1e-3
tire_step_size = step_size

# Time interval between two render frames
render_step_size = 1.0 / 50  # FPS = 50

# Create the FEDA vehicle, set parameters, and initialize
vehicle = veh.FEDA()
vehicle.SetContactMethod(contact_method)
vehicle.SetChassisCollisionType(chassis_collision_type)
vehicle.SetChassisFixed(False)
vehicle.SetInitPosition(chrono.ChCoordsysd(initLoc, initRot))
vehicle.SetTireType(tire_model)
vehicle.SetTireStepSize(tire_step_size)

vehicle.Initialize()

vehicle.SetChassisVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetSuspensionVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetSteeringVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetWheelVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetTireVisualizationType(vis_type)

vehicle.GetSystem().SetCollisionSystemType(chrono.ChCollisionSystem.Type_BULLET)

# Create the terrain
patch_mat = chrono.ChMaterialSurfaceNSC()  # Corrected: use ChMaterialSurfaceNSC for NSC contact method
patch_mat.SetFriction(0.9)
patch_mat.SetRestitution(0.01)
terrain = veh.RigidTerrain(vehicle.GetSystem())
patch = terrain.AddPatch(patch_mat,
                         chrono.ChCoordsysd(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, terrainHeight), chrono.QUNIT),
                         terrainLength, terrainWidth)

patch.SetTexture(veh.GetDataFile("terrain/textures/tile4.jpg"), 200, 200)
patch.SetColor(chrono.ChColor(0.8, 0.8, 0.5))
terrain.Initialize()

# Create the vehicle Irrlicht interface
vis = veh.ChWheeledVehicleVisualSystemIrrlicht()
vis.SetWindowTitle('FEDA vehicle')
vis.SetWindowSize(1280, 1024)
vis.SetChaseCamera(trackPoint, 6.0, 0.5)
vis.Initialize()
vis.AddLogo(chrono.GetChronoDataFile('logo_pychrono_alpha.png'))
vis.AddLightDirectional()
vis.AddSkyBox()
vis.AttachVehicle(vehicle.GetVehicle())

# -------------------------------
# Driver System Modification:
# Replace interactive driver with path-follower, cruise-control driver system
# Create a path that follows the ISO standard double lane change maneuver
# Set target speed = 10.0
# Configure steering controller with look-ahead distance = 5 and appropriate gains
# Configure speed controller with appropriate gains
# -------------------------------

# Create the path for the double lane change maneuver
# The ISO double lane change maneuver is defined by a series of points.
# We'll create a ChLinePath with these points.

# Reference: ISO 3888-2 double lane change maneuver approx points (in meters)
# The maneuver is typically about 60 m long, so points are spaced accordingly.
# We'll define points relative to the vehicle initial position (-50,0,0.5),
# so the path starts near x=-50 and goes forward in +x direction.

# Define points for the double lane change maneuver (x,y)
# These points approximate the maneuver shape:
path_points = [
    chrono.ChVector2d(-50, 0),      # start
    chrono.ChVector2d(-40, 0),      # straight
    chrono.ChVector2d(-35, 3.5),    # lane change right
    chrono.ChVector2d(-30, -3.5),   # lane change left
    chrono.ChVector2d(-25, 3.5),    # lane change right
    chrono.ChVector2d(-20, 0),      # back to center lane
    chrono.ChVector2d(10, 0)        # end of maneuver
]

# Create the path object
path = veh.ChLinePath()
for p in path_points:
    path.AddPoint(p)

path.Set_closed(False)

# Create the path-follower driver
target_speed = 10.0  # m/s

driver = veh.ChPathFollowerDriver(vehicle, path, "my_path", target_speed)

# Configure steering controller
# Look-ahead distance = 5 m
driver.GetSteeringController().SetLookAheadDistance(5.0)
# Set steering controller gains (typical values)
driver.GetSteeringController().SetGains(0.8, 0, 0.1)  # kp, ki, kd

# Configure speed controller gains (typical values)
driver.GetSpeedController().SetGains(0.4, 0, 0.05)  # kp, ki, kd

driver.Initialize()

# Output vehicle mass
print("VEHICLE MASS: ", vehicle.GetVehicle().GetMass())

# Number of simulation steps between miscellaneous events
render_steps = math.ceil(render_step_size / step_size)

# Initialize simulation frame counter
realtime_timer = chrono.ChRealtimeStepTimer()
step_number = 0
render_frame = 0

while vis.Run():
    time = vehicle.GetSystem().GetChTime()

    # Render scene and output POV-Ray data
    if (step_number % render_steps == 0):
        vis.BeginScene()
        vis.Render()
        vis.EndScene()
        render_frame += 1

    # Get driver inputs
    driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()

    # Update modules (process inputs from other modules)
    driver.Synchronize(time)
    terrain.Synchronize(time)
    vehicle.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs, terrain)
    vis.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs)

    # Advance simulation for one timestep for all modules
    driver.Advance(step_size)
    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle.Advance(step_size)
    vis.Advance(step_size)

    # Increment frame number
    step_number += 1

    # Spin in place for real time to catch up
    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)
```
